ayahs.1: Yeh log kis cheez ke baare mein poochh-gachh kar rahe hain.
ayahs.3: Jis ke baare mein yeh ikhtilaaf kar rahe hain.
ayahs.5: Phir bil-yaqeen unhein bahut jald maloom ho jaayega.
ayahs.6: Kya hum ne zameen ko farsh nahin banaya?
ayahs.8: Aur hum ne tumhein joda joda paida kiya.
ayahs.9: Aur hum ne tumhari neend ko aaraam ka sabab banaya.
ayahs.10: Aur raat ko hum ne parda banaya.
ayahs.11: Aur din ko hum ne waqt-e-rozgaar banaya.
ayahs.12: Aur tumhare oopar hum ne saat mazboot aasman banaye.
ayahs.14: Aur badliyon se hum ne ba-kasrat behta hua paani barsaya.
ayahs.15: Taake is se anaaj aur sabza ugaen.
ayahs.17: Beshak faisle ke din ka waqt muqarrar hai.
ayahs.18: Jis din ke soor mein phoonka jaayega. Phir tum fauj-dar-fauj chale aaoge.
ayahs.19: Aur aasman khol diya jaayega to is mein darwaze hi darwaze ho jaaenge.
ayahs.20: Aur pahaad chalaaye jaaenge, pas woh saraab ho jaaenge.
ayahs.23: Is mein woh muddaton tak pade rahenge.
ayahs.24: Na kabhi is mein khunki ka maza chakhenge, na paani ka.
ayahs.25: Siwaye garam paani aur (behti) peep ke.
ayahs.27: Unhein to hisaab ki tawaqqo hi na thi.
ayahs.28: Aur be-baaki se hamari aayaton ki takzeeb karte the.
ayahs.29: Hum ne har ek cheez ko likh kar shumaar kar rakha hai.
ayahs.30: Ab tum (apne kiye ka) maza chakho, hum tumhara azaab hi badhaate rahenge.
ayahs.31: Yaqeenan parhezgaar logon ke liye kaamyaabi hai.
ayahs.33: Aur naujawan kunwaari hum-umr aurten hain.
ayahs.35: Wahan na to woh be-hooda baatein sunenge aur na jhoothi baatein sunenge.
ayahs.36: (Un ko) tere Rabb ki taraf se (un ke nek aamaal ka) yeh badla milega jo kaafi inaam hoga.
ayahs.37: (Is Rabb ki taraf se milega jo ke) aasmanon ka aur zameen ka aur jo kuchh un ke darmiyan hai un ka Parwardigaar hai aur badi bakhshish karne wala hai. Kisi ko is se baat-cheet karne ka ikhtiyar nahin hoga.
ayahs.38: Jis din rooh aur farishte saffen baandh kar khade honge to koi kalaam na kar sakega, magar jise Rahman ijaazat de de aur woh theek baat zabaan se nikaale.
ayahs.39: Yeh din haq hai, ab jo chaahe apne Rabb ke paas (nek aamaal kar ke) thikaana bana le.
ayahs.40: Hum ne tumhein anqareeb aane wale azaab se dara diya (aur chaukanna kar diya) hai. Jis din insaan apne haathon ki kamaai ko dekh lega aur kaafir kahega ke kaash main mitti ho jaata.
